field_principles.duplicate_solve_target_avoided: True only when the synthesis does not target an already reached live solve depth.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Must start with complete:/complete_/success:/success_ and state whether a live patch is gated for exp5241.
field_principles.live_agent_reachability_evidence: Test command, dry-run receipt, or null.
field_principles.model_specs: MODEL_SPECS with mandated SOTA GGUF if any LLM proposer was used; otherwise null.
field_principles.patch_failure_mode_targeted: One of skill_selection, skill_following, composition, reflection, provenance_routing, or none.
field_principles.patch_path: Path to the code or configuration patch, or null when no patch is justified.
field_principles.patch_test_ready: BARE top-level boolean for Exp 5241. True only when a test or dry-run receipt proves the live agent can reach the candidate.
field_principles.recommended_live_patch_available: BARE top-level boolean for Exp 5241. True only when one evidence-backed live-path patch candidate exists.
field_principles.registry_precheck_done: True only when ops/arc_solve_registry.yaml was read before patch recommendation.

honest_verdict: success: provenance-routing live patch is gated for exp5241 without a solve claim.

guard.routing_rule: Before registry promotion or reusable candidate-pool routing, require live-agent self-discovery provenance and honor rolled-back ARC memory actions as block or quarantine guardrails.

patch_candidate.summary: Before registry promotion or reusable candidate-pool routing, require live-agent self-discovery provenance and honor rolled-back ARC memory actions as block or quarantine guardrails.
